posts.title: 🐥 Running Independent Work Concurrently in Elixir without Losing Your Error Handling
posts.description: Some workflows are slow, not because the work is hard, but because we do it one step at a time. A typical example is a pipeline that calls an LLM (or any slow external service) several times: clean up a body of text, generate a title, produce a social media blurb, and suggest tags.
